style: Create a NEW image in exactly the same art style as the reference images: soft painterly semi-realistic digital illustration, lifelike natural people with realistic faces and expressions, cinematic lighting, deep purple / magenta tones with teal-cyan glow accents, slight film grain. Vertical 9:16 full-frame composition that fills the whole frame, no empty borders. Absolutely no text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks. The main character is always the same young brunette athletic woman (long brown hair in a ponytail, early twenties, fit and sporty, natural beauty) as in the character reference image.

images.char: Character portrait: a young brunette athletic woman, early twenties, long brown hair in a high ponytail, fit and sporty, wearing a fitted teal sports jacket over a purple top, friendly confident natural face, upper body, purple background with cyan rim light.
images.hook: The young brunette woman walks on a busy evening city sidewalk toward the camera, while a man staring at his phone walks straight toward her on a collision course, both in the center of the frame, neon city lights.
images.eyes: Extreme close-up of the young brunette woman's eyes, glowing cyan lines and arrows coming out of her gaze, showing the direction she is looking, purple light.
images.dance: The young brunette woman and a young man on a sidewalk facing each other, both stepping to the same side at the same time, awkward mirrored movement, embarrassed smiles, motion blur on their feet.
images.nose: The young brunette woman and a man stand face to face, almost nose to nose on a sidewalk, both frozen and awkward, wide eyes, funny tension.
images.shuffle: Top-down bird's-eye view of a city sidewalk with two pedestrians walking toward each other, glowing dotted cyan and pink path lines showing their zig-zag dodging trajectories.
images.brainpath: Side profile of the young brunette woman walking, a translucent glowing brain in her head projecting holographic trajectory lines and a predicted collision point ahead of her.
images.meter: The young brunette woman and an oncoming pedestrian on a sidewalk, a glowing holographic distance line between them on the ground, both just starting to step aside.
images.gaze: The young brunette woman walking on a sidewalk, clearly looking to her left, a glowing cyan arrow on the ground showing where she looks, an oncoming man notices her gaze.
images.read: An oncoming young man glances at the young brunette woman's eyes and smoothly steps to the other side, they pass each other easily, glowing path lines.
images.phone: The young brunette woman walking while looking down at her glowing smartphone, oblivious, people around her on a busy sidewalk, purple neon city.
images.crash: Strict side profile view, like a theatre stage: on the LEFT half the young brunette woman FACING RIGHT, on the RIGHT half a young man FACING LEFT. They are walking in OPPOSITE directions straight into each other, face to face, their chests and phones bumping together in the exact center of the frame. Both look down at their phones until the moment of impact. The man holds exactly ONE smartphone in his right hand, nothing else. A coffee cup flies up from the collision point and splashes. Comic shocked faces. City sidewalk at night, plain background, no other people.
images.confident: The young brunette woman striding confidently and purposefully down a crowded sidewalk, people naturally making way for her, cinematic low angle.
images.trick: The young brunette woman walking and looking straight ahead at a glowing teal path line on the sidewalk in front of her, calm and focused, an oncoming person in the background.
images.space: The smiling young brunette woman walking through a crowd that parts smoothly in front of her, glowing path, triumphant feeling.
images.ask: The young brunette woman stopping on the sidewalk and turning to the camera with a playful questioning grin, crowd blurred behind her.
images.follow: The confident smiling young brunette woman pointing directly at the viewer, glowing rings behind her, purple and magenta background with cyan rim light.
